authorization: Boxuan authorized autonomous discussion and cleanup of disposable development data on 2026-08-11; canonical/main/high-risk boundaries remain unchanged.

dispositions.RETAIN: Keep because it is outside the disposable allowlist or is required evidence/nutrition.
dispositions.TTL: Keep only for a bounded provider/runtime retention period; prefer platform expiry over custom deletion.
dispositions.DISPOSABLE: May be deleted only inside allowlisted candidate/sandbox work areas after dry-run classification.

rules: Apply may delete only an explicitly classified DISPOSABLE path under an allowlisted work area.
Path traversal and symlink escape fail closed.
Non-empty directories fail closed; cleanup must enumerate files explicitly before directory removal.
Canonical evidence, authorization, state, closure, governance, identity and handoff anchors are never automatic cleanup targets.
Secret-like paths are protected and their contents must not be read, hashed, logged, copied or persisted by the cleanup engine.
For safe disposable files, the cleanup manifest may retain path, reason, size and SHA-256, but never file contents.
GitHub Actions artifacts should use provider TTL/retention-days instead of custom destructive deletion when possible.
No main/default-branch write, PR merge, deployment, publication, account/permission expansion, money movement or canonical Drive deletion is authorized by this policy.
phase1_definition_of_done: path traversal and symlink escape are tested
phase-1 closure records retained nutrition, disposed waste and next candidate
